This Agreement ismade and entered into this
dayof

WITNESSETH:
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of themutual covenants and conditions contained
herein, it is hereby agreed asfollows:
1.That the Club shall perform the following services during the City's 2021-2022
season for Youth Co-Rec Volleyball League, Adult Volleyball League, and Adult Co-Rec
Volleyball League.
a.
The Club shall provide and assign one (1) official for the Youth Co-Rec
Volleyball League match and two(2)officials to each Adult and Adult Co-Rec
Volleyball League match to officiate according to the schedule provided to the Club by
the City; the second official keeps score and line judges. The Club shall provide the City
with a schedule of the officials assigned to each match at least one (1) week in advance of
eachmatch.
b. The Club shall provide the City with a list of names and telephone
numbers of all Club personnel and officials at least one (1) week before the start of the
season. The Club will update the list as changes occur and provide a copy to the City.
1:
c.The Club shall ensure that all officials assigned to the matches are
properly trained and will perform their duties in accordance with the current year's
Cheyenne Community Recreation and Events, Recreation Division's By-Laws, Code of
Conduct, governing rules, and any applicable addendum to these documents. By-Laws
and Code of Conduct are incorporated into the Agreement by reference.
d.
Officials are required to wear a uniform designated by the Club.
e.
The Club will report all player ejections to the City on the provided form
within two (2) working days of the ejection.
f.The Club shall ensure that officials sign-in with the gym supervisor at
least fifteen (15) minutes prior to the scheduled match time.A sign-in sheet will be
provided to the gym supervisor by the City. In the event an official is late signing in or
does not comply with this Agreement, the Club will be fined as follows:
i.Five Dollars ($S5.00) if official is not signed in with gym supervisor
fifteen (15) minutes prior to start of match;
i.Eight Dollars and Fifty Cents ($8.50) if second official (Adult
Leagues only) arrives after the first game of the match that started;
i.Ten Dollars ($10.00) if second official (Adult Leagues only)
arrives after the second game of the match that started;
does not arrive for entire match;
v.Ten Dollars ($10.00) for each score reported incorrectly;, and

vi.
Five Dollars ($5.00) for not being properly dressed as stated in this
Agreement.
. A fine sheet shall be submitted every week to the Club.
2.
The City shall pay the Club:
a.
Twenty Dollars ($20.00) per match for each Youth League (one official),
and Forty Dollars ($40.00) per match for each Adult and Co-Rec League (two officials)
officiated by the Club;
b.A fee of One Hundred Fifty Dollars (S150.00) for the Fall Adult League,
One Hundred Fifty Dollars ($150.00) for the Winter Adult Co-Rec League, and One
Hundred Fifty Dollars ($150.o0) for the Youth League for training, scheduling, and
administrative costs. This fee shall be paid by the City in full on the first invoice
provided by Club;
C.T
The City will notify Club of any cancellations or forfeiture by 3:30 p.m.
the day of the scheduled match. If notification is made after 3:30 p.m., City will pay Club
the matchfee; and
d. If the City has notified the Club of a second or third (middle match), Club
will be paid at the rate of Ten Dollars ($10.00) per official to hold referees.
3.The City shall not pay the Club if both officials are missing from an Adult League
volleyball match at the scheduled game time. The match shall be deemed to have not been
officiated by the Club and the Club will not be paid for the match.The Club will be fined Forty
Dollars ($40.00) for the match.

for the entire term of the Agreement.

the City of Cheyenne as an Additional Insured by endorsement on its insurance
and shall provide the City with a copy of the endorsement.

6. Independent Contractor. At all times during the term of this Agreement, the Club
shall be considered an independent contractor. Neither the Club nor anyone employed by it shall
represent, act, purport toact, orbe deemed tobe the agent, representative, employee, orservant
ofthe City.
7.Acceptance Not Waiver. The City's approval of, acceptance of, or payment for
any of the services of this Agreement shall not be construed to operate as a waiver of any of the
City's rights under this Agreement or any of its legal rights under statute or common law arising
out of the performance of this Agreement.
8. Default. Every term and condition contained in this Agreement, including
payment obligations, shall be deemed a material element of this Agreement. In the event either

Remedies.
a.
In the event that the City declares the Club in default of this Agreement,
the City shall notify the Club in writing.The Club shall be allowed a period of fifteen
(15) days to cure the default.In the event the default remains uncorrected, the Club may
elect to:
i.
Terminate the Agreement and seek damages;
ii.
Treat the Agreement as continuing and require specific
performance; or
ii.
Avail itself of any other remedy at law or equity.

Termination.The City representative may, by fifteen (15) days written notice to
the Club, terminate this Agreement in whole or in part for the City's convenience.In the event

termination.
